fieldValues.title: 11. Mapping the systems onto the handbook
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
Handbook stage → system that classifies it:
- Domain, persona, problem, remedy: system 1 only.
- Intake: system 1 (kind: bug, friction or feature; proposed in clerk#56).
- Objective and period, epic: system 2 (epic Priority from the period rank).
- Work item: systems 1, 2, 3 and 4 (kind by label; priority; status; size and complexity).
- Priority and queue: systems 2 and 3.
- Working groups, assignment and claim: system 3 (wg, lane, ready, claim).
- Execution: systems 5 and 7 where the work is a decision (Doors in srs, ADRs in srs-rust).
- Review and merge: system 8 (mode × door; gate labels).
- Report, session and ratification: systems 1 and 6 (decision lifecycle, modes, kinds).
- Measurement: system 1 (indicators); nothing else.
fieldValues.tensions: - Systems 5, 6 and 7 classify decisions and spec changes and enter the work flow only at execution and review.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: - Is a spec change a kind of work item (so Doors are a classification) or a kind of decision (so Doors belong with system 6)?
